## Accepted partial result

For finite simple undirected loopless graphs, unit initial edge counts and arbitrary positive vertex rates, surviving support is almost surely a forest for alpha>4/3. The cycle theorem handles nonuniform weights, unequal rates, chords and attachments: every even cycle is unstable for alpha>1, and an odd m-cycle is unstable for alpha>sec^2(pi/(2m)). The known equal-rate triangle is strictly stable and positively attainable for 1<alpha<4/3, giving the sharp lower obstruction. The stochastic endpoint alpha=4/3 is excluded.

For equal positive rates, whisker-forest support holds for alpha>=17/4, improving the prior >25 bound. All five scalar exponent intervals, exact rational margins, fractional-power comparisons and the analytic tail are included in the proof. No omitted coefficient table, generated certificate, program or numerical search is a proof dependency.

The full bundled target remains OPEN: the equal-rate whisker interval 4/3<alpha<17/4 is unresolved. The exact stable unequal-rate diameter-four path at alpha=2 is a scope control, not a counterexample to that equal-rate target. No infinite-graph or loop/multigraph extension is asserted.

The full mathematical proof and all substantive independent audit findings are preserved. The proof's only edit is its opening problem-label sentence; audit wrapper edits distinguish the original audited bytes from the distributed edition. No mathematical correction was required.

## Credit and review limits

The stochastic transfer uses the published Hirsch-Holmes-Kleptsyn 2023 Theorem 1 and Proposition 1, including unit initial counts, convergence to stable/critical equilibria, strict-stability attainment and support identification:
https://doi.org/10.1088/1361-6544/acc9a0
https://pure.au.dk/ws/portalfiles/portal/418609000/Hirsch_2023_Nonlinearity_36_3013.pdf
Holmes-Kleptsyn 2017 supplies the credited least-weight argument, prior structural bounds and unequal-rate warning:
https://doi.org/10.1063/1.4978683
https://researchers.ms.unimelb.edu.au/~mholmes1@unimelb/Reinforced-graphs_final.pdf
Original two-clause problem and known triangle obstruction:
https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2023/12

No novelty or priority is claimed. The manuscript and audit are AI-assisted and unrefereed; acceptance is not external human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant certification. The historical source search is bounded, not exhaustive literature clearance.

## Distribution

Exactly eight authored proof/audit/acceptance/status/source-review or public verification-metadata files are added under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30005455/`. Programs, raw outputs, generated certificates, datasets, copied source documents/text/images and private coordination are excluded. Historical finite checks are supplementary. Preparation rechecked frozen input bytes, editorial preservation and publication integrity without new scholarly-source retrieval, source-text inspection, literature search or mathematical-program reruns. QUEUE.md and all unrelated content are unchanged. No merge, release, DOI, journal submission or outreach is requested.

The finite simple loopless WARM preprint answers the two literal numerical-improvement requests in Kleptsyn's OWR12/2023, printed page 655. For arbitrary positive vertex firing rates and arbitrary fixed positive integer initial counts, surviving support is almost surely a forest for alpha > 4/3. For equal rates it is almost surely a whisker forest for alpha >= 17/4. The known triangle supplies the strict forest lower obstruction. The stochastic endpoint alpha = 4/3 and sharper equal-rate whisker interval 4/3 < alpha < 17/4 remain unresolved. No arbitrary positive real initialization, infinite-graph, loop or multigraph extension is asserted.

The five files under unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30005455/preprint contain the seven-page paper, source-and-verification ZIP, exact metadata, flat two-file deposit manifest and README. All eight original submissions at bacae693a1f2a33c89565b0bd716620885831289 remain unchanged inside the frozen ZIP. Current README/STATUS/MANIFEST reconcile historical partial/OPEN labels with the literal improvement requests; five original mathematical/source artifacts retain their bytes. QUEUE.md is unchanged.

Published HHK2023 convergence/support inputs, even-cycle and uniform odd-cycle methods, the known triangle and HK2017 least-weight/champion arguments are credited. The earlier proof already implies a weaker whisker bound at24. Two independent bounded primary-source priority investigations recovered no earlier full universal result; no exhaustive priority, worldwide firstness, first public-availability or current global-openness certificate is claimed.

Validation includes two sequential independent whole-package reviews, distinct mathematical and priority challenges, exact source/ZIP custody checks and nine portable finite-control replays. Finite controls supplement the universal written proof. AI tools were extensively involved in research, proof development, computation, auditing, literature investigation and writing. This is an unrefereed preprint without formal independent human peer review, journal acceptance or proof-assistant certification.
